name: verifiedpermissions
description: Amazon Verified Permissions is a permissions management service from Amazon Web Services.

subcommands.name: batch-get-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a group (batch) of policies.

subcommands.name: batch-is-authorized
subcommands.description: Makes a series of decisions about multiple authorization requests for one principal or resource.

subcommands.name: batch-is-authorized-with-token
subcommands.description: Makes a series of decisions about multiple authorization requests for one token.

subcommands.name: create-identity-source
subcommands.description: Adds an identity source to a policy store–an Amazon Cognito user pool or OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider (IdP).

subcommands.name: create-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a Cedar policy and saves it in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: create-policy-store
subcommands.description: Creates a policy store.

subcommands.name: create-policy-store-alias
subcommands.description: Creates a policy store alias for the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: create-policy-template
subcommands.description: Creates a policy template.

subcommands.name: delete-identity-source
subcommands.description: Deletes an identity source that references an identity provider (IdP) such as Amazon Cognito.

subcommands.name: delete-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified policy from the policy store.

subcommands.name: delete-policy-store
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: delete-policy-store-alias
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified policy store alias.

subcommands.name: delete-policy-template
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified policy template from the policy store.

subcommands.name: get-identity-source
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details about the specified identity source.

subcommands.name: get-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified policy.

subcommands.name: get-policy-store
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a policy store.

subcommands.name: get-policy-store-alias
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about the specified policy store alias.

subcommands.name: get-policy-template
subcommands.description: Retrieve the details for the specified policy template in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: get-schema
subcommands.description: Retrieve the details for the specified schema in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: is-authorized
subcommands.description: Makes an authorization decision about a service request described in the parameters.

subcommands.name: is-authorized-with-token
subcommands.description: Makes an authorization decision about a service request described in the parameters.

subcommands.name: list-identity-sources
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of all of the identity sources defined in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: list-policies
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of all policies stored in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: list-policy-store-aliases
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of all policy store aliases in the calling Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-policy-stores
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of all policy stores in the calling Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-policy-templates
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of all policy templates in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the tags associated with the specified Amazon Verified Permissions resource.

subcommands.name: put-schema
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the policy schema in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified Amazon Verified Permissions resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified Amazon Verified Permissions resource.

subcommands.name: update-identity-source
subcommands.description: Updates the specified identity source to use a new identity provider (IdP), or to change the mapping of identities from the IdP to a different principal entity type.

subcommands.name: update-policy
subcommands.description: Modifies a Cedar static policy in the specified policy store.

subcommands.name: update-policy-store
subcommands.description: Modifies the validation setting for a policy store.

subcommands.name: update-policy-template
subcommands.description: Updates the specified policy template.
